patterns.evidence_shape: status=EXECUTED, validation.result=pass, governance_status present, no authority_effect, no explicit lifecycle transition
patterns.authority_conclusion: Execution state is bounded process evidence, not authority promotion.

patterns.evidence_shape: status=PASS, validation_results and validation_commands present, files_changed present, rollback_result present, no authority_effect
patterns.authority_conclusion: PASS validation and implemented effects describe bounded work and verification; patch-record authority remains separate.

field_separation_contracts: status separates execution/process state from authority.
validation.result and validation_results separate verification state from authority.
files_changed separates implementation evidence from authority.
authority_effect is the existing explicit authority dimension, and it is absent for all C03 items.

shared_lookup_leak.reason: Registry surfaces remain authoritative for governed ledger, debt, and patch records.
shared_lookup_leak.consequence: Generic lookup still collapses registry patch-record presence into live authority candidacy for both executed-only and pass-bundle records.
